FAQs

Who is the API for?

Engineering teams, developers and partners looking to build custom workforce workflows or integrations.

How is this different from integrations?

Integrations offer robust, pre-built connections. APIs give you the flexibility to build custom workflows and experiences.

Is the API secure and compliant?

Yes—Deel’s APIs are built with enterprise-grade security, permissions, and audit controls.

Do I need to be a partner to use the API?

No. Deel’s APIs are available to both customers and partners, with access designed to support a wide range of custom automation and platform use cases.

How can I build on Deel’s API as a partner?

Learn more about our API partnership program, which allows you to build apps and integrations featured in our App Marketplace.
